purpose: AM2: reject shape-valid producer data that violates a consumer semantic boundary

boundary.output: compatible or ordered semantic rejection reason; malformed/out-of-profile requests raise jsonschema.ValidationError, never compatibility.
invariants: Archive schema validation does not establish consumer compatibility
Payload digest binds canonical JSON content (not original serialization bytes); unknown required semantics reject.
No unit, basis or fractional-volume coercion
Only explicitly supported producer 1.0.0 / consumer major 1 can match; equal unknown versions are not eligibility.
Synthetic rights/freshness declarations do not establish real provider permission or live freshness

limits: No domain rewrite or shared schema change
No entitlement, session calendar or provenance certification
New matcher is a bounded offline reference model, not general composition engine
Loop-design branch and real queue remain untouched
